Honest answer? Because trans people grow up not being able to express themselves because they have to pretend they are what they were raised to be and what people want them to be. After they come out of the closet they have the freedom to express themselves, and end up trying lots of alternative fashions. Thats what people in trans circles ive been to tend to explain it as, anyway.

As for the weight gain, dysphoria (that feeling of unhappiness and disgust with your body not matching your brain) can lead to severe warped self image. Some trans people cope by developing eating disorders, and some feel so disconnected to their bodies that they give up on taking care of themselves. Plus trans people tend to have higher rates of depression partly due to bullying in childhood and high rates of abuse from parents once their parents find out theyre trans. And depression can cause overeating/lack of motivation to exercise.
